### About

I spent three years at Deluxe Media leading 250+ global film and TV titles through QC, localization and delivery for OTT, broadcast and physical release, then ran production workflows at Northeastern University's Recording Studios while finishing an MS in Project Management. My first degree is in Audio Engineering, so I'm happiest where media, music and technology meet.

### Right now

- Building **Mez**, a self-hosted workspace for Hermes Agent (private beta)
- Evaluating LLM output for model training at **Mercor**
- Volunteer Project Manager for **Lyrical Literacy** at Humanitarians AI: a fellows handbook, Suno and Midjourney tutorials, and a weekly explainer video on audio and AI
- Open to full-time **Project, Product, Program and Operations Manager** roles (open to relocation)

### Selected work

- **[Chop](https://musichackspace.org/events/hackathon-boston-june-2026/projects/175)** 🏆 *2nd place, Berklee Music Tech Hackathon*: a VST3 sample browser that lets producers describe a sound in plain language, find it in their library or generate it with AI.
- **Mez** *(private beta)*: an installable web app that gives Hermes Agent a home on your phone and laptop: chat, scheduled jobs, goals coaching, notices, bookings that wait for your approval, a live view of the agent's browser, a terminal and file editor, server controls and an audit log.
- **[WealthTrack](https://wealthtrack-demo.vercel.app/)**: an AI-powered personal finance dashboard with real-time transaction aggregation.
- **MetricLab**: a monday.com portfolio dashboard my capstone team built for an early-stage radiopharmaceutical company, with a project registry, milestone tracker, risk log and RAG health reporting for leadership.
- **[HuskyHub](https://www.figma.com/proto/5FF1p7XpF1ZZIlgdZ10oox/HuskyHub-Wireframe?node-id=368-565&t=FGf5Jv6rp15YZyfL-1&starting-point-node-id=368%3A565)**: a Lean, AI-enabled campus rental app, from scope to Figma prototype.

More projects, and the full story, on **[rohanvijaykumar.cv](https://rohanvijaykumar.cv)**.
